assignment_rule: Each card receives exactly one independent-human and one isolated-LLM attempt. Neutral cards do not disclose an expected verdict. Challenge cards disclose one intended defect family and are reported separately from natural cards.

cards.title: Left-to-right payload handover
cards.goal: Implement a complete transfer of payload_alpha from the left arm to the right arm and finish with only the receiver responsible for the payload.
cards.freedom: Choose durations, synchronization and operation order naturally.

cards.title: Conditional collaborative transfer
cards.goal: When ready is true, transfer payload_beta between the two arms; otherwise perform a coherent one-arm payload_beta cycle.
required_elements: one collaborative and one single-arm branch
cards.freedom: Choose transfer direction, single-arm side, durations and synchronization.

cards.title: Shared tool in two turns
cards.goal: Let both arms use tool_beta in two distinct work turns and finish with the tool available.
cards.freedom: Choose ordering and whether synchronization is useful.

cards.title: Input-selected fixture user
cards.goal: Use ready to select which arm performs one timed fixture_alpha work cycle; both branches must terminate normally.
cards.freedom: Choose durations and branch-local API order.

cards.title: Carried payload with concurrent arm motion
cards.goal: Have one arm carry payload_alpha while both arms perform their matching approach or retreat motions in one parallel phase and rendezvous once.
cards.freedom: Choose the carrier, trajectory direction, timing and final payload action.

cards.title: Two-arm approach and regroup
cards.goal: Move both arms through their matching trajectories concurrently, rendezvous, and complete a short arm-local operation in each lane.
cards.freedom: Choose approach or retreat and the arm-local operations.

cards.title: Premature sender release challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible payload_alpha transfer workflow that intentionally releases the sender before a valid stationary dual-grasp authority transfer is complete.
cards.freedom: Choose direction, durations and the rest of the workflow.

cards.title: Invalid receiver handover challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible payload_beta transfer workflow that intentionally changes authority without first establishing a valid stationary dual grasp in the handover zone.
cards.freedom: Choose direction, durations and surrounding operations.

cards.title: Competing shared-tool acquisition challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible two-lane workflow in which both arms intentionally compete for tool_beta before the current owner releases it.
cards.freedom: Choose timing, barriers and the remainder of each lane.

cards.title: Wrong-owner release challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible conditional fixture_alpha workflow with at least one reachable branch in which an arm intentionally releases or uses the resource without valid ownership.
required_elements: ready or mode with both branches
both arm names across the program
cards.freedom: Choose branch structure, durations and surrounding valid-looking work.

cards.title: Attached-payload collision challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible parallel workflow intended to make a payload carried by one arm intersect the other arm during matching approach/retreat motions.
cards.freedom: Choose carrier, trajectories, timing and final actions.

cards.title: Cross-arm overlap challenge
cards.goal: Write a plausible two-lane motion workflow intended to create a cross-arm collision interval through unsafely synchronized approach/retreat motions.
cards.freedom: Choose trajectory directions, waits and barrier placement.
